# LX05 accepted GP04 input data

`e09.json` is the exact root-accepted GP04-E09:1 synthetic provider corpus,
SHA256 `2b34157e91c7065045f1f407c92a915eb246db48070f09c0a44e97bb86261685`.
It contains invented signed PCM24 and descriptor/refusal vectors, no recordings
or provider source/algorithms. Protocol is GP04-local:1 / C-ANALYSIS:1:
4-byte BE framing, 6280-byte GAW1 windows, oldest first-packet monotonic time,
ten unchanged GPA1 packets, four explicitly ordered raw-pre-fader sources.
Lux independently decodes and analyzes these samples with its existing analyzer.
Old LX03/LX04 corpora remain byte-identical.

`commands.json` and [WIRE.md](WIRE.md) publish actual lx05-v1 owner output shapes,
commands/replies, absent/unready refusal, AUTO mode-entry and Assist continuity.
Their exact hashes are checkpointed for independent/root acceptance before use
by Lightdesk. The default normal test compares the actual owner-generated corpus.

`features.json` contains actual qualified PCM → owner feature/AUTO/loss/manual
inventories and a command/reply, generated by the independent Lux decoder and
existing Calibrator/Analyzer/Director over exact E09 data. The injected acquisition
clock makes this a deterministic software corpus; physical timing remains unknown.
